title: Cyber Attack Paths
description: A small company network: hosts, open ports, vulnerabilities and accounts. Find how an attacker could reach the customer database.

questions.question: Which internet-exposed hosts have a known vulnerability?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (:Zone {name: 'Internet'})-[r:CAN_REACH]->(h:Host)-[:HAS_VULNERABILITY]->(v:Vulnerability)
RETURN h.name AS host, r.port AS port, v.cve AS cve, v.name AS vulnerability, v.severity AS severity
ORDER BY severity DESC

questions.question: What is the shortest path from the internet to the customer database?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (src:Zone {name: 'Internet'}), (dst:Host {name: 'customer-db'})
WITH shortestPath((src)-[:CAN_REACH*]->(dst)) AS p
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.name] AS attack_path, length(p) AS hops

questions.question: Which paths to the customer database pass only through vulnerable hosts?
questions.cypher:
MATCH p = (:Zone {name: 'Internet'})-[:CAN_REACH*]->(:Host {name: 'customer-db'})
WHERE all(h IN nodes(p)[1..-1] WHERE (h)-[:HAS_VULNERABILITY]->())
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.name] AS attack_path, length(p) AS hops
